aliases: ハイパークロックアップ
official_definition: Hyper Clock Up - (When Attacks/Blocks) This Spirit can't be blocked. Also, if the opponent would use a Flash effect, they can't use it unless they pay three extra costs.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Hyper Clock Up] or [Hyper Clock Up: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Hyper Clock Up]", "give [Hyper Clock Up]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
